title: High-Performance Substrate — Proposed Architecture Pipeline
pipeline_overview: JSON/JSONL/CSV canonical artifacts → schema validation / redaction scan → optional Arrow in-memory batches → optional Parquet derived snapshots → PostgreSQL operational projection → DuckDB analytical views → cockpit/static docs/procurement packs → optional pgvector semantic retrieval over approved/redacted/content-light representations

pipeline_stages.name: Canonical Artifact Layer
pipeline_stages.description: JSON/JSONL/CSV files remain the portable, inspectable, diffable, replayable, schema-governed source-of-truth artifacts.
pipeline_stages.artifact_boundary: All writes produce canonical artifacts. All reads originate from canonical artifacts.
pipeline_stages.schema_boundary: All artifacts validated against docs/schemas/*.schema.json via jsonschema.
pipeline_stages.redaction_boundary: rig_relay/evidence/redaction.py — all artifacts scanned for forbidden content before write.
pipeline_stages.failure_mode: Corrupted artifacts are quarantined — written to quarantine log, not ingested.
pipeline_stages.replay_behavior: All downstream stages can be fully rebuilt from canonical artifacts.
pipeline_stages.test_requirement: Artifact roundtrip tests: write → read → validate → write → SHA256 match.

pipeline_stages.name: Schema Validation & Redaction Scan
pipeline_stages.description: All data crossing the boundary from runtime to storage passes through schema validation (jsonschema) and content-light redaction scan (redaction.py).
pipeline_stages.artifact_boundary: Consumes canonical artifacts, produces validation records (artifact_validation).
pipeline_stages.redaction_boundary: Forbidden field patterns (token, secret, private_key, raw_prompt, raw_completion, file_content, diff, patch) rejected. No raw content crosses into downstream stages.
pipeline_stages.failure_mode: Invalid artifacts are quarantined with structured error record. Valid artifacts pass through.
pipeline_stages.replay_behavior: Validation runs are replayable — same input always produces same validation result.
pipeline_stages.test_requirement: Content-light enforcement tests: insert known forbidden payloads, verify rejection.

pipeline_stages.name: Arrow In-Memory Batches (prototype — Phase 3)
pipeline_stages.description: Optional Arrow table representation for efficient in-memory data interchange between subsystems. Not a persistent format.
pipeline_stages.artifact_boundary: Arrow is transient in-memory — never persisted as canonical artifact.
pipeline_stages.schema_boundary: Arrow schema derived from Pydantic models via pyarrow.Schema.from_pydantic() or manual definition.
pipeline_stages.redaction_boundary: Arrow batches only contain content-light fields — same enforcement as JSON artifacts.
pipeline_stages.failure_mode: Arrow conversion failure falls back to dict-of-dicts. Never a hard dependency.
pipeline_stages.replay_behavior: Not replayable — transient in-memory. Always rebuildable from canonical artifacts.
pipeline_stages.test_requirement: Arrow ↔ dict roundtrip preserves schema-governed fields. Arrow ↔ Pydantic model roundtrip.

pipeline_stages.name: Parquet Derived Snapshots
pipeline_stages.description: Cold/warm derived analytical snapshots in Parquet format. Not canonical event truth — canonical artifacts remain JSON/JSONL/CSV.
pipeline_stages.artifact_boundary: Parquet snapshots are derived — never source-of-truth. Always rebuildable from canonical JSONL artifacts.
pipeline_stages.schema_boundary: Parquet schema matches canonical artifact schema. DuckDB COPY FORMAT PARQUET preserves column types.
pipeline_stages.redaction_boundary: Parquet snapshots produced from already-validated, redaction-passed JSONL. Defense-in-depth: Parquet read path should still validate content-light.
pipeline_stages.failure_mode: Corrupted Parquet snapshots are discarded and rebuilt from canonical JSONL.
pipeline_stages.replay_behavior: Parquet snapshots can be rolled back by rebuilding from canonical artifacts. Not replayable in the audit sense.
pipeline_stages.test_requirement: Parquet snapshot never becomes canonical event truth. Parquet → JSONL roundtrip preserves content-light fields. Parquet → DuckDB query parity.

pipeline_stages.name: PostgreSQL Operational Projection
pipeline_stages.description: Postgres tables (event_log, receipt_envelope, coordination_lease, finding, release_gate_decision, enterprise_audit_event, etc.) are operational read replicas. Canonical authority remains with JSON/JSONL/CSV artifacts.
pipeline_stages.artifact_boundary: Postgres operational tables are downstream projections. Artifacts remain canonical. Postgres tables can be fully rebuilt from artifacts via COPY import.
pipeline_stages.schema_boundary: Postgres tables use generated columns from JSONB payloads. CHECK constraints enforce content-light and schema_version format. Staging table + constraint promotion absorbs COPY imports.
pipeline_stages.redaction_boundary: INSERT triggers reject forbidden field keys. CHECK constraints validate content-light patterns. Defense in depth with application-layer redaction.
pipeline_stages.failure_mode: Postgres unavailable → fail-closed. PostgresUnavailableError raised. No silent fallback.
pipeline_stages.replay_behavior: Full replay from canonical artifacts via psycopg COPY import. Export back to canonical JSONL via COPY export.
pipeline_stages.test_requirement: Postgres COPY import validates staging table constraints. Postgres COPY export roundtrips to canonical JSONL. Generated column values match JSONB source.

pipeline_stages.name: DuckDB Analytical Views
pipeline_stages.description: In-memory DuckDB reads local JSONL/Parquet files for ad-hoc analytical queries. Postgres operational tables for dashboard materialized views when Postgres is configured.
pipeline_stages.artifact_boundary: DuckDB is read-side only — never writes back to artifacts. Postgres path reads from materialized views.
pipeline_stages.schema_boundary: DuckDB queries extract envelope-level fields only. Postgres path uses typed generated columns.
pipeline_stages.redaction_boundary: DuckDB queries only select content-light columns. Postgres views only expose content-light materialized views.
pipeline_stages.failure_mode: DuckDB unavailable → AnalyticsEngine raises RuntimeError. Postgres unavailable → fail-closed in enterprise mode. Local mode falls back to DuckDB.
pipeline_stages.replay_behavior: DuckDB projections are ephemeral. Postgres materialized views are rebuildable.
pipeline_stages.test_requirement: DuckDB vs Postgres projection parity. DuckDB reads content-light only.

pipeline_stages.name: Cockpit / Static Docs / Procurement Packs
pipeline_stages.description: Cockpit projection assembly, static documentation rendering, and procurement evidence pack generation consume content-light data from upstream stages.
pipeline_stages.artifact_boundary: Cockpit projections are runtime-only. Static docs are derived HTML. Procurement packs are derived JSON bundles.
pipeline_stages.schema_boundary: All outputs validated against their declared schemas. No raw content in any output.
pipeline_stages.redaction_boundary: Static docs safety scan (safety.py) detects token/secret leaks before publish. Procurement packs are content-light by construction.
pipeline_stages.failure_mode: Projection assembly failure → widget shows 'Unavailable'. Static docs render failure → build fails. Procurement pack failure → partial pack with error manifest.
pipeline_stages.replay_behavior: All outputs rebuildable from upstream canonical artifacts.
pipeline_stages.test_requirement: Projection overwrite regression tests. Static docs scan catches absolute paths/tokens/source snippets. Procurement pack uses content-light derived summaries only.

pipeline_stages.name: pgvector Semantic Retrieval (park — Phase 6)
pipeline_stages.description: Vector similarity search over content-light reports, findings, and remediation plans. Embeddings over private repo content are sensitive derived data — must be local-only and policy-approved.
pipeline_stages.artifact_boundary: Embeddings are derived data. Canonical artifacts remain JSON/JSONL/CSV.
pipeline_stages.schema_boundary: pgvector vector columns store embeddings. Embedding metadata (model, dimension, content_sha256) stored as typed columns.
pipeline_stages.redaction_boundary: Embeddings over private repo content are classified as sensitive derived data. Must be local-only. Must not be exported to product telemetry. Must be covered by sensitive-derived-data policy.
pipeline_stages.failure_mode: pgvector unavailable → semantic search returns empty. Standard FTS and GIN index queries continue to work.
pipeline_stages.replay_behavior: Embeddings can be regenerated from canonical artifacts. Not replayable in the audit sense — embeddings are lossy.
pipeline_stages.test_requirement: Embeddings never store raw private repo text unless explicitly local-only and policy-approved. Embedding records classified as sensitive derived data.
